allow: PowerShell(foreach \($f in 'style2','grass','sky2','music2','plaza2','mainstreet','house2','sea2'\) { $p = "js\\$f.js"; if \(Test-Path $p\) { $len = \(Get-Item $p\).Length; $lines = \(Get-Content $p | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines; $r = node --check \(Resolve-Path $p\) 2>&1; $ok = if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { 'syntaxe OK' } else { 'ERREUR' }; "{0,-12} {1,7} octets {2,5} lignes  {3}" -f $f, $len, $lines, $ok } else { "{0,-12} absent" -f $f } })

PowerShell($files = @\('js\\game.js', 'C:\\Users\\binze\\Desktop\\DouceVallee\\js\\game.js'\); foreach \($f in $files\) { $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText\(\(Resolve-Path $f\), [Text.Encoding]::UTF8\); $n0 = \([regex]::Matches\($t, 'finishCam\\\(C, p, m\\\)'\)\).Count; $t = $t.Replace\('finishCam\(C, p, m\); return;', 'finishCam\(C, p, m, dt\); return;'\).Replace\("    finishCam\(C, p, m\);`n  }", "    finishCam\(C, p, m, dt\);`n  }"\).Replace\('function finishCam\(C, p, m\) {', 'function finishCam\(C, p, m, dt\) {'\); [IO.File]::WriteAllText\(\(Resolve-Path $f\), $t, \(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding\($false\)\)\); $c = \([regex]::Matches\($t, 'finishCam\\\(C, p, m, dt\\\)'\)\).Count; "$f : appels corrigés = $c \(avant: $n0\)" })
